status: exploratory sensitivity policy; no forecast or fitted trade rule
fee_note: All dated all-in fees and most perp fees are assumptions, not verified account rates or upper bounds. The older perp launch advertised as low as 2bps with a $0.15 floor; it does not verify dated fees. Exchange-only dated fees exclude customer brokerage and clearing. Spreads are separate, funding additional.
notes: BTC and ETH are separate alternatives, never two simultaneous $5000 allocations in a $5000 account.
Terminal gap and funding values are hypothetical; zero convergence is not guaranteed.
The common price and current displayed depth stay constant within each carry scenario.
Gross cap applies to initial notional; fixed quantities can exceed it after price changes.
Cash opportunity cost is assessed on all $5000; collateral yield assumed zero.
